note: BAC Guatemala's personal banking tariff (updated 1 July 2026): a quetzal current account (monetaria) is charged 30 quetzales for account handling in a month whose average balance is under 2,500 quetzales; dormancy, chequebook and per-transaction charges aren't modelled.

sources.title: BAC Guatemala, Tarifario Banca de Personas (updated 1 July 2026)
sources.said: Actualización 01 de Julio de 2026 ... MONETARIOS ... Q30 por saldo promedio mensual inferior a ... MANEJO DE CUENTA ... Q2,500.
